Name: Simple Silo Upgrade
Author: Xsyy
Description:
Running out of hay storage? Simply Silo Upgrades lets you upgrade your existing silos through Robin instead of building more across your farm.

Start with the regular [b]240-hay silo[/b], then upgrade to [b]480, 960, and 1,920 hay[/b]. Every tier keeps the same [b]3×3 footprint[/b] and has its own brick appearance, with iron reinforcements and stone foundations as you progress.
[b]
Your hay stays available during construction[/b], so you can continue feeding your animals while Robin works. The extra capacity becomes available when the upgrade finishes.

More than extra storage

Interact with a silo to check your shared hay supply, deposit hay, or withdraw it directly into your backpack. The menu also estimates how many full days your hay could feed your animals.

A visible fill indicator helps you check your reserves at a glance. Optional low-hay reminders and full-storage notifications help you stay on top of supplies.

[b]Upgrade costs[/b]
[list]
[*][b]480 hay:[/b] 2,500g, 100 Wood, 50 Stone and 5 Copper Bars. Takes 1 work day.[/*]
[*][b]960 hay:[/b] 7,500g, 150 Wood, 100 Stone and 5 Iron Bars. Takes 2 work days.[/*]
[*][b]1,920 hay:[/b] 20,000g, 50 Hardwood, 200 Stone and 10 Iron Bars. Takes 2 work days.[/*]
[/list]Upgrades are purchased in order, with fixed prices.

[b]Languages and installation
[/b]
Includes [b]12 languages[/b], automatically matching your game language: English, Chinese (Simplified), Spanish, Portuguese (Brazilian), Russian, German, French, Japanese, Korean, Italian, Turkish and Hungarian.

Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ and SMAPI 4.4.0+[/b]. Extract the mod into your
[code]Mods[/code]folder and visit Robin to get started. Existing silos can be upgraded.

For multiplayer, everyone needs the same mod version. Online and split-screen testing is still ongoing.
